body.one_liner: Adobe's exceptional FCF generation and ROIC are partially an accounting artefact — Peters-Taylor intangible-capital restatement reveals a meaningful gap — but the business still clears a high quality bar; the composite watchlist verdict reflects depressed momentum, not structural deterioration.

bull.headline: Exceptional cash economics: FCF margin above 40% with near-zero leverage
bull.detail: F5 scores strong_fit driven by a FCF margin that leaves most software peers behind and a Debt/EBITDA that is effectively negligible. Combined with a three-year revenue CAGR in the double digits, the business is self-funding at scale — a core compounding prerequisite under Buffett's hold framework.

bull.headline: GAAP ROIC of 56.5% signals deep competitive advantage, even after intangible restatement
bull.detail: Even adjusting downward by the Peters-Taylor gap flagged in ICA-5, economic ROIC remains at a level that materially exceeds most software benchmarks. High and sustained ROIC is the empirical fingerprint of switching-cost and intangible-asset moats (Helmer: Switching Costs + Process Power); the direction of the derivative — whether this is widening or eroding — is the key variable to monitor over the hold period.

bull.headline: Fundamental quality high: Piotroski 7/9, shrinking asset base, Sloan accrual quality confirmed
bull.detail: F1 strong_fit is grounded in improving balance-sheet fundamentals (Piotroski 7/9), disciplined capital deployment (asset base shrinking — bottom decile by Cooper-Gulen-Schill), and clean earnings (Sloan high quality = True), alongside top-decile gross profitability per Novy-Marx. The absence of recent insider buying is a gap in the full pre-discovery archetype but does not negate the fundamental signals.

bull.headline: Valuation z-scores in very_cheap band across both EV/Rev and P/B dimensions
bull.detail: F7 scores maximum, with both EV/Revenue and Price-to-Book z-scores in the very_cheap band. For a business with ROIC materially above cost of capital and a Rule-of-40 above 50, historically cheap relative multiples create an asymmetric setup — the left tail (multiple compression) is limited when you are already at the bottom of the z-score distribution. Note the academic dispute cited in F7 notes; this signal is intentionally weighted at 0.10 in the composite.

bull.headline: Earnings surprise streak of 7 consecutive quarters signals disciplined guidance management
bull.detail: F3 records a 7-quarter positive PEAD surprise streak. Sustained beats against forward estimates indicate either conservative guidance culture or structural demand visibility — both are qualitative signals consistent with the switching-cost moat hypothesis. Average gross margin expansion of 53 bps per year adds to the compounding quality narrative.

bear.headline: Peters-Taylor restatement reveals 18.84pp ROIC gap — intangible capital is larger than GAAP acknowledges
bear.detail: ICA-5 fires because economic ROIC (Peters-Taylor capitalisation of R&D as knowledge capital and 25% of SG&A as organisational capital) sits materially below GAAP ROIC. The direction is downward: economic capital efficiency is lower than GAAP implies because the invested-capital base is inflated by intangibles GAAP expenses. This does not negate the moat, but owners should hold economic ROIC — not GAAP ROIC — as the true efficiency signal.

bear.headline: Momentum signal is a clear fail: 12-1 momentum of -30.1%, still 26% off 52-week high
bear.detail: F2 scores 3.0 (fail band). Price-based momentum is the most liquid signal of shifting market perception. A drawdown of this magnitude against a backdrop of otherwise strong fundamentals signals either macro-driven multiple compression or a market forming a negative view on growth durability that the fundamentals have not yet confirmed. The PEAD signal is positive_drift — post-earnings buying exists — but the trend-level signal is clearly negative.

bear.headline: No insider buying in the open-market window — zero 90-day buyers despite the drawdown
bear.detail: F1 records zero open-market buyers in the trailing 90-day window. At a time when the stock sits 26% below its 52-week high, the absence of insider conviction buying is a notable gap in the bull case. Combined with non-disclosure of CEO equity percentage, alignment between management and long-term shareholders cannot be verified from available data.

bear.headline: F6 Platform Dominator scores partial: NRR and GRR undisclosed, Fahlenbrach signal negative
bear.detail: F6 scores 4.0 (partial/moderate). Despite a Rule-of-40 above 50, the platform thesis is penalised by management's non-disclosure of net and gross revenue retention — the two SaaS metrics most directly tied to moat durability. Fahlenbrach signal is False (CEO equity alignment not confirmed). For a $23.8B revenue franchise, the absence of retention disclosure weakens the compounding-in-place argument.

bear.headline: BEW verdict: no_winner_pattern — extreme-compounder tail is not confirmed
bear.detail: The Bessembinder Extreme Winner overlay returns no_winner_pattern. This matters for sizing and hold-duration conviction: the concentrated-position, hold-forever case requires the BEW tail to be live. Without it, the thesis is a high-quality business at a reasonable price — compelling, but not a structurally rare compounding event that demands position sizing above normal limits.

risks.factor: Monitor whether economic ROIC (Peters-Taylor basis) continues to converge toward or diverge from GAAP ROIC over the next 2-3 annual filings. A widening gap would signal accelerating intangible spend without commensurate economic return — a thesis-erosion condition, not a timing signal.

Track gross margin trajectory annually. Current expansion of 53 bps/yr is modest; any reversal into gross margin compression would indicate pricing power or mix deterioration inconsistent with the moat thesis.

Watch for insider open-market purchase activity over the next 4 quarters. Continued absence of insider buying as the stock remains well below its prior high would compound the alignment concern; resumption would partially resolve it.

Monitor whether Adobe begins disclosing NRR/GRR in MD&A. If the company continues to withhold these metrics as peer SaaS companies disclose them, it may reflect deteriorating cohort retention dynamics — a direct platform-moat checkpoint.

EPS acceleration signal is 'net_increase_with_dips' — not clean acceleration. Monitor whether dips represent cyclical noise or a structural deceleration in earnings quality across 2-3 more reporting periods before updating the thesis.

Momentum failure (F2 score 3.0, 12-1 momentum -30.1%) may reflect emerging competitive disruption from generative-AI entrants attacking Adobe's creative workflow moat. This is the thesis-break scenario to distinguish from simple multiple compression: watch for revenue growth deceleration or customer-count stagnation in Creative Cloud cohorts.

R&D intensity data gap (F3) prevents full assessment of innovation spend trajectory. Until a complete multi-year R&D intensity series is available, the Innovation Compounder framework cannot be scored at full resolution — creating a blind spot in moat-direction assessment.

data_caveats: F3 Innovation Compounder: R&D intensity could not be computed — no annual filing period with rd_intensity data available. R&D band and intensity signals are scored as unknown. This creates a partial score floor for F3 regardless of other signals.

F4 Stealth Accumulation: options put/call ratio was not computed — no free-tier data source available per project spec (Pan-Poteshman 2006 methodology). Short interest current and peak figures are withheld as third-party data. F4 scoring rests only on EPS acceleration and decline-signal inputs.

F6 Platform Dominator: Net Revenue Retention (NRR) and Gross Revenue Retention (GRR) are not_disclosed by Adobe in its 10-K MD&A. These are scored as zero-point signals. F6 score would be higher if retention metrics were disclosed and positive.

Company-level: market_cap_usd, beta, PE trailing, EV/EBITDA, and PB ratio are null in the view — these fields were not populated for this run. Composite scoring proceeds on framework signals; market-cap-dependent stage reasoning uses the profitable_3yr and established_threshold check instead.
CEO equity percentage is not_disclosed — Fahlenbrach alignment signal in F6 and CEO alignment in F5 are scored as no_alignment / False accordingly.
